messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Horizon Summit: executive one-pager, case card, and demo script — review needed

Team —

Attached are the working assets for the Brightline panel slot at Horizon Summit next week. We need quick signoff on the following items so the field team can finalize print and the co-marketing team can route the case card to Brightline for approval:

- Executive one-pager (PDF) — hero messaging + 2 bulletized differentiators for latency/cost for customer infra.
- Customer case card (Word) — Brightline quote placeholder (needs Angela's final quote).
- Demo script (MD) — 4-minute live demo + 2 fallback prompts if latency spikes.
- Slide deck (PPTX) — speaker notes on slide 6 and 9 need concise customer outcomes.

Big asks:
1) Marcus — can you confirm the demo script timings (I flagged a ~30s overrun on step 3).
2) Ben — field checklist: do we need any hardware/adapter callouts for the booth?
3) Laura — any branding/legal changes required before print?

I've also uploaded all files to the Horizon Summit assets folder (link below). Please reply with edits inline or comment in the doc by EOD Monday PST. We need print-ready PDFs by Tuesday AM.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3HorizonSummitAssets

Thanks —
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0119

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Horizon Summit: executive one-pager, case card, and demo script — review needed

Neha —

Thanks for pulling these together. Quick notes after a pass through demo_script_v4.md:
- Step 3 (customer dataset ingest): you're right — the network upload + precompute adds ~30s on our baseline. Recommend trimming the live ingest to 60s and moving the remaining prep to a "pre-warmed" KV cache slide (we can simulate a warm run).
- Replace the long CLI example with a single composite command and callout that we will not run in the live demo (keeps cadence tighter).
- Add an explicit fallback line after prompt #2: "If latency exceeds 400ms, switch to cached response (slide 9)."

I've made inline edits in the drive doc (comments). Also added a short speaker note for slide 6 showing the cost comparison (2.4x cheaper per 1k tokens with caching).

I'll be at the booth setup on Tuesday morning so can run a dry rehearsal at 8:30 if that helps.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Product Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Horizon Summit: executive one-pager, case card, and demo script — review needed

Neha / team —

Field checklist notes:
- Booth LAN will be NATed; we should assume ~150ms additional RTT for external API calls. Plan for the cached fallback Marcus suggested.
- Bring two laptops: primary for live run, backup pre-warmed VM that serves cached outputs. Also bring a USB-C to Ethernet adapter (we have spares but flagging).
- Print sizing: one-pager looks good at 8.5x11 but please move the logo 0.25in up to avoid bleed (Laura can confirm with brand).
- For the case card: Brightline requested a short one-line compliance blurb (SOC2 mention). Angela — we'll need the exact language you prefer.

I'll confirm hardware in staging on Monday and tag the shipping labels.

Ben
Ben Carter
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks for sharing — this looks great. A couple quick items from Brightline: 
- Happy with the one-pager phrasing — please swap the customer outcome line to: "Reduced inference cost by 48% while maintaining 95th percentile latency SLOs".
- For the case card compliance blurb please use: "Brightline Health is SOC 2 Type II compliant; Redwood processes production inference under our DPA."
- Quote: you can use: "Redwood's serving runtime allowed us to scale inference without custom ops work — the demo speaks for itself." — Angela Soto, VP, Platform Engineering.

We are available to review final PDFs tomorrow morning before print.

—Angela

All —

Thanks for the fast turn. Laura (branding) here:
- Logo bump request acknowledged — Ben, we'll update layout and export print-safe PDF.
- Legal copy: the SOC2 blurb Angela provided is fine; procurement asked that we also include a two-sentence DPA summary on the back of the case card (I added a 50-word placeholder in the doc). Legal will send final DPA-approved phrasing by noon Monday.
- Print-ready deliverables: Neha, please consolidate Marcus's demo edits and Angela's quote, then export the one-pager and case card to PDF. Send final PDFs to me and copy legal for signoff by 9am Tuesday.

I'll mark the current files as approved for design work except for the DPA sentence.
